rows.name: Lyon Arboretum Fall Plant & Craft Sale
rows.venue_name: Harold L. Lyon Arboretum (surrounding the Visitor Center and Greenhouse)
rows.schedule_text: Friday Dec 4 and Saturday Dec 5, 2026, 9 AM to 3 PM each day
rows.organizer: Harold L. Lyon Arboretum, University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa
rows.description: Fall plant and craft sale at Lyon Arboretum in Mānoa Valley with local vendors, music and food. Plants include tropical ornamentals, Hoya, natives, ferns, orchids, jade vines, aroids, gingers, bromeliads and carnivorous plants from Lyon's Horticulture Dept., Hui Ku Maoli Ola, Laʻau Hawaiʻi, Olomana Tropicals, Lang's Nursery, Mix Plate Nurseries, Nuʻuanu Orchids and others. Also aloha shirts, local honey and art. Proceeds support Lyon Arboretum's conservation, education and research.
